text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: `ModelCatalog: default_revision_mismatch` fired for `model-catalog` (P1) - increased 5xx on model lookup, possible tokenizer/metadata mismatch. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-catalog#default-revision

sylvia (oncall): acked on PD, I'm on it. paging details: https://pagerduty.com/incident/INC12345 :eyes:

sylvia (oncall): quick triage: dashboards show spike in model-catalog 500s starting 03/07 02:12 UTC. stacktrace includes `TokenizerNotFoundError` and `model revision metadata missing tokenizer` for model-id `redwood/llama-13b-v2`.

ben (eng-sre): copying logs locally, can you dump the catalog lookup for that model-id? I want to see `default_revision` value returned to infra.

sylvia (oncall): pasted sample request/response:
```
GET /catalog/models/redwood/llama-13b-v2
200 {
  "model_id": "redwood/llama-13b-v2",
  "default_revision": "rev-2026-03-07-staging",
  "metadata": {
    // note: tokenizer field missing in this manifest
  }
}
```
Result: runtime gets a revision with no tokenizer mapping -> runtime fails when initializing tokenizer -> 500s.

deploy-bot: catalog-sync job `catalog-sync-nightly` ran at 2026-03-07T02:10:15Z, job id `job-7849`. It updated 42 model entries; changed default_revision for `redwood/llama-13b-v2` from `rev-2026-03-02-stable` to `rev-2026-03-07-staging`.

morgan (eng-platform): preliminary root cause: staging manifest was promoted into the prod object storage due to a tag collision in the registry ingestion step. The sync job doesn't currently validate tokenizer metadata presence before flipping `default_revision`. I'm putting up a PR to gate updates.

ben (eng-sre): mitigation idea: pin default_revision back to stable for now, and block further catalog-sync runs until we patch validation. Can you perform pin via the admin API?

sylvia (oncall): doing the pin now. Command I ran:
```
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood/models/redwood/llama-13b-v2/pin" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ONCALL_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"default_revision":"rev-2026-03-02-stable","reason":"emergency pin due to missing tokenizer metadata"}'
```
API response: 200 OK. Default revision reverted.

sylvia (oncall): I also temporarily set a routing fallback for requests to this model to `rev-2026-03-02-stable` at the router level to avoid cache warmup issues.

kayla (customer-success): heads up — we've already got 3 high-value tenants (acme, dynaproc, medsys) seeing errors; CS is sending an initial incident notification and offering a mitigation plan. I'll update customers once we confirm stability.

ben (eng-sre): running canary smoke tests now. quick check:
```
for i in {1..20}; do curl -s https://api.redwood/generate?model=redwood/llama-13b-v2 | jq .status; done
```
All responses now 200 OK, tokenizer loads fine.

morgan (eng-platform): pushed hotfix to catalog-sync to add a validation step and reject manifests that don't include tokenizer metadata for revisions. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/platform/+/PR-4527. Will also add a post-update hook that rechecks a sample of revisions.

ben (eng-sre): also added an alert rule to detect when `default_revision` changes without a corresponding `tokenizer` field in manifest.

sylvia (oncall): escalated to SEV board for postmortem. Action items so far:
- revert pin to be replaced by validated sync (morgan)
- add manifest validation in registry ingestion (morgan)
- add catalog change audit + alert (ben)
- customer notifications (kayla)
- add integration test to prevent staging tags colliding (eng-qa)

sylvia (oncall): handing off to ben for monitoring and follow-ups — I'll be out for a short break, back at 1772160389. Ben, take next 90m? :hand: @ben

ben (eng-sre): taking over. I'll keep this thread updated and will escalate if anything new pops. Current status: mitigated (pinned), smoke tests green, customers notified.

morgan (eng-platform): deployed the validation hotfix to prod sync service at 2026-03-07T03:10Z. Verified it rejects the bad manifest on dry-run.

kayla (customer-success): received confirmation from acme that their calls are back to normal; medsys is still doing some validation but reported reduced error rate.

pagerduty: Incident `INC12345` marked `acknowledged` by sylvia.

ben (eng-sre): marking incident status as 'mitigated - recovery in progress'. I'll open postmortem doc and link in this thread when ready.

morgan (eng-platform): note for postmortem: root cause = registry tag collision + lack of validation in catalog-sync leading to a bad `default_revision` with missing tokenizer metadata. Remediation = add validation + audit + integration tests.

ben (eng-sre): incident resolved at 2026-03-07T04:19:49Z. Final notes: 3 tenants impacted, ~12k requests errored over 2 hours, no data loss. Follow-up: postmortem doc created: https://docs.internal/incidents/INC12345-postmortem

sylvia (oncall): thanks everyone. closing the PD incident after handoff verification. Will add timeline + todos to postmortem. :white_check_mark:
